svg.title: Prospective source construction for 131 unit squares
svg.desc: The source-selected n=131 construction, normalized to Witness/v1 and drawn with the repository deterministic house renderer. This is a feasible construction, not an optimality or chunk-structure claim.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Coordinates were recovered from the public six-decimal SVG rendering, not the unavailable governed interval boxes named by its metadata. This checks the displayed construction only and does not replay the source interval claim or prove optimality.
